{"consolidated_memory":"CONFLICT LOOP IN SYNC ENGINE — Six Separate Incidents

Component: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (Swift, mobile sync side)
General Problem: Conflict loop where two clients rewrite each other on every pass
Reproduction: Edit the same note on two devices offline
Covering Test: mobile/ios/SyncEngineTests.swift

All six incidents are distinct occasions with separate root causes and fixes:

OCCASION 1 [2026-03-23] — Off-by-One in Slice Bound
- Trigger: First request after cold start
- Root Cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test (PR #1178, branch fix/conflict-loop-1)
- Result: 87 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

OCCASION 2 [2026-04-17] — Missing Composite Index
- Trigger: Only for clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root Cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #2371, branch fix/conflict-loop-2)
- Result: p99 latency fell from 2.5 s to 425 ms

OCCASION 3 [2026-05-19] — Schema Drift Between Migration and Model
- Trigger: Only for traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root Cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #3160, branch fix/conflict-loop-3)
- Result: Backlog cleared 7 minutes after the deploy

OCCASION 4 [2026-07-12] — Cache Entry Never Invalidated on Write
- Trigger: Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root Cause: A cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction (PR #4888, branch fix/conflict-loop-4)
- Result: Throughput rose 18 percent, to 314 requests per second

OCCASION 5 [2026-07-30] — Two Writes Not Wrapped in Transaction
- Trigger: Only after the client had already retried once
- Root Cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #5832, branch fix/conflict-loop-5)
- Result: Error rate dropped from 7.6 percent to under 2 per ten thousand

OCCASION 6 [2026-08-01] — Clock Skew Between Hosts
- Trigger: Only on the staging read replica
- Root Cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #8421, branch fix/conflict-loop-6)
- Result: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 40 days running"}
